findings.title: Edges may reference issues that belong to no epic
findings.specimen: attavo/plan.py: shape_errors at build commit d9e3b41d29273796fcbe82b8f357aa8d5f92a1c7
findings.retires: The assumption that validating edge numbers and self-edges establishes the approved invariant that every issue belongs to an epic.
findings.severity: Blocking when either endpoint of an accepted edge is absent from every epic; that state makes the Plan contain an issue with no home.

findings.title: Ruled edges accept empty ruler and time values
findings.specimen: attavo/plan.py and schema/plan.schema.json at build commit d9e3b41d29273796fcbe82b8f357aa8d5f92a1c7
findings.retires: The assumption that requiring string-typed `by` and `at` fields means a ruled edge names who ruled it and when.
findings.severity: Blocking when an accepted ruled edge has an empty or whitespace-only `by` or `at`, because the ruling then lacks the identity or time required by the approved contract.

findings.title: Malformed and contradictory CLI options are silently interpreted as valid operations
findings.specimen: attavo/plan.py: cmd_plan at build commit d9e3b41d29273796fcbe82b8f357aa8d5f92a1c7
findings.retires: The assumption that the documented command grammar is enforced by the Plan CLI.
findings.severity: Blocking when malformed input changes the selected state or writes a version—for example, `get --version nope` returns the latest plan and `rank ... --before ... --last` performs a write instead of refusing the contradictory request.
